\begin{document}

\begin{lemma}[Vanishing lemma]
Assume that $H^1(X,\mathcal O_X)=0$.
Then the desired vanishing holds.
\label{lem:vanishing}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proposition}
By Lemma~\ref{lem:vanishing}, we obtain the intermediate result.
\label{prop:key}
\end{proposition}

\begin{theorem}[Main theorem]
Using Proposition~\ref{prop:key}
and Lemma~\ref{lem:vanishing},
we obtain the main result.
\label{thm:main}
\end{theorem}
